posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
So, her character arc runs something like this:

  • Young Kismet has a stream of minor encounters, which she inevitably loses, including against The Sentinels (lands her in jail) and Setback (lands her in The Block).  Her first major event is the prison break in The Block.
  • From The Block, she ends up in Atlantis.  This is the the first real Kismet event with multiple heroes involved, so this is probably the canonical "original card" Kismet battle.  We know Ra, Visionary, and Haka (at least) were part of this battle, and Guise was also there.
  • She gets paroled from The Block and ends up in Mittermeier's, so this is Trickster Kismet.  She and Glamour capture the Naturalist, which attracts other heroes.  This is presumably the canonical Trickster battle.

So once the event goes live, I'd probably start fiddling around with the Atlantis battle setup.  Since Kismet never actually fares well in a battle against heroes, not sure if she has to achieve anything herself, like getting lots of Jinxes out.  I suppose it's possible she might have to win a battle in The Block, but story-wise she never battled any heroes there.

posts.cooked:
A useful post of the status of the hunt on the Steam forum....

---

Originally posted by penteractcubegod:

OK, reading what I can into everything, the only essentially guranteed factor is The Block. here are the possible factors.

 

1. KNYFE in first slot

2. Having won vs Kismet in the past

3. Kismet flipping at least once

4. Imminent Destruction has been played

5. Imminent Destruction destroys Lock Down

6. Unlucky Break has been played

7. Fanatic and AA on team

 

If you have all 7 of these, I'm almost certain you'll unlock. Try to eliminate them 1 at a time, starting with number 2, as it can't be undone. Of course, you must be on block. Feel free to copy/paste this list and add or remove items. If you have done all 7 and didn't unlock, please tell me.

---

Since that post, users there seem to have knocked out Items 1, 5, and 6 as factors (since logs/screenshots there show wins without them)

So, After having previously defeated Kismet, lose to her in The Block with a team that includes Fanatic, AA, and KNYFE. Kismet must flip at least once and Imminent Destruction must have been played.

I'm worried that if we're not close here, that it might involve more specific details about how Kismet was previously defeated, which will be hard to test. OTOH, this almost seems like too easy a condition for a villain variant unlock when compared to what's required for the other ones.
